Mortar]] |gender=Male |nature=Hasty |ability={{a|Intimidate}} |type1=Fire |media=special |noevo=incap |epnum=PS117 |pokemonname=Arcanine |epname=Slugging It Out with Slugma |prevonum=059 |current=[[Party|With Crystal]] |va=no }} '''Archy''' (Japanese: '''ウインぴょん''' ''Winpyon''), known as '''Arckee''' in [[Chuang Yi]]'s translations, is an {{p|Arcanine}} owned by {{adv|Crystal}} in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}. As of ''[[PS450|With a Little Help From Hitmonchan]]'', he is at [[level]] 79, and his [[Characteristic]] is that he "likes to run." ==History== ==={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}=== [[File:Crystal and Archy.png|thumb|left|200px|left|Archy and Crystal]] Archy was first seen in ''[[PS117|Slugging It Out with Slugma]]'' at [[Mt. Mortar]] when {{adv|Crystal}} was {{pkmn|training}} to become a capture pro. During her training, Archy was a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} out of control due to an eye injury from a {{p|Larvitar}}. Due to his attack, Crystal fell and broke her arms. When she later awoke, a group of wild Pokémon helped her recover. After figuring out what happened, she went looking for Arcanine to see what caused his rampage. When she found him, she noticed his eye and had {{p|Parasect}} nurse his eye back to health. Noticing that he was not naturally aggressive, Crystal decided to add him to her team. Archy then showed up alongside Crystal's other Pokémon to help prove her capturing skills to {{adv|Professor Oak}}. In ''[[PS131|Suddenly Suicune (Part 2)]]'', Archy battled {{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Suicune}} to try and help Crystal capture it. After failing the capture, Crystal sends Archy and [[Bonee]] after it. Bonee rides on Archy and uses {{m|False Swipe}} while Archy tackles it. While it appears Suicune blocked, it soon became obvious that a translucent wall between Suicune and Bonee was made. Archy, alongside Crystal and Bonee, attempt to keep the wall from closing but in the end Suicune closes it and escapes. [[File:Archy vs Larvitar.png|thumb|right|175px|left|Archy facing the Larvitar that injured him]] In ''[[PS135|Lively Larvitar]]'', Archy helped with Crystal's training on Mt. Mortar. Suddenly, Archy growls, and the Larvitar that injured him before appears. It then begins attacking Archy, while targeting the right side where he has trouble seeing. Due to this Archy is quickly defeated and [[Megaree]] finishes the battle for him. ==={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}=== In ''[[PS448|Pleased as Punch With Parasect]]'', Archy battled [[Team Rocket]] Executive [[Ariana]] and her {{p|Gloom}}, attacking with a powerful {{m|Flamethrower}}. Despite putting up a good fight, he was recalled when Crystal left the battle to chase {{adv|Arceus}}. {{-}} ==Personality and characteristics== Archy is a very quick-tempered Pokémon and often rushes into battle using his incredible speed. Archy has proven to be a strong battler and is {{adv|Crystal}}'s main mode of transportation. Due to a {{p|Larvitar}} attacking him he has bad eyesight on the right side. This can be used to his disadvantage, as Pokémon aware of this weakness are able to use this to win against the Legendary Pokémon despite Archy being the stronger Pokémon. ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|fire||Archy {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=ExtremeSpeed|1=Ember|2=Bite|3=Exbo Flame Wheel|4=Flamethrower}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Extreme Speed|1=Ember|2=Bite|3=Flame Wheel|4=Flamethrower}}}} {{anmov|Normal|Extreme Speed|PS117|Slugging It Out with Slugma }} {{anmov|Fire|Ember|PS118|Three Cheers for Chikorita}} {{anmov|Dark|Bite|PS133|Absolutely Azumarill}} {{anmov|Fire|Flame Wheel|PS165|Lugia and Ho-Oh on the Loose, Part 1}} {{anmov|Fire|Flamethrower|PS448|Pleased as Punch With Parasect|rec=yes}} {{anmov/f|fire}} ==Trivia== * Archy is the only one of Crystal's Pokémon whose nickname does not end with 'ee'.
